title: Independent audit: nonlinear dirty restoration and exact PR628 leaf count
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**Independent verification; no new κ.** PR628's balanced dirty commutator allows `4*n*n` primitive calls. This standalone audit proves the exact count `C(n)=3*q*n-2*q*q`, where `q=2^floor(log2(n))`, with sharp supremum `9*n*n/8`. The exact count can replace the conservative allowance in the inherited execution-error budget; asymptotic precision and pass orders remain unchanged. At `n=62`, it accounts for 3904 calls instead of the allowance of 15376.

An independent free-term interpreter checks the pinned recursive dispatcher with arbitrary deterministic nonlinear leaf functions. A separate free noncommutative algebra checks the ideal linear product without assuming factor commutation. The written induction confirms exact source/scratch restoration, target independence and inverse-word ordering under the stated primitive contract. No defect was found in this scoped obligation. A concrete example distinguishes exact scratch restoration from independence of the output increment from initial dirt, corroborating PR628's caveat.

The subject is Chafik Boukhalfa's #628 at `0768f97d06c623b8211e651543c66135796b62bf`; its dispatcher and notice are retained byte-for-byte for offline replay. Base commit: `66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60`. Source pins, predecessor credit, track/seed 62, bounded coverage, overlap review and the completed local claim are in `research/dirty-commutator-audit/`.

This adds evidence distinct from #628's dense rational accuracy tests. It does not re-audit rounded leaf accuracy, coefficient preparation, bit/tape costs, routing, full-transform composition or multiplication. No selected pointer, existing generator, or `upstream/` file changes. No priority or formal theorem certification claim is made.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -B research/dirty-commutator-audit/verify.py --check
```

Expected: PASS for 64 symbolic factor counts, 10,000 exact recurrence cases, seven instruction/interface rejection controls, and a nonlinear dirt counterexample.

The same check passes under optimized Python and from a relocated standalone package with isolated imports. Corrupt vendored input and corrupt expected-certificate controls both fail under isolated optimized Python. The unchanged selected-record integrity check and staged whitespace check pass. Python 3.14.7/macOS, standard library only; no remote CI or repository-wide regenerating suite pass is claimed.

The finite symbolic checks support the separate written all-n proof; they are not a formal proof of the multiplication theorem. Prepared for @0xkilgore with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including a separate mathematical reviewer. Apache-2.0; PR628's attribution and assistance notice are preserved.
